title: Orchestrator improvement scout
summary: A periodic Watcher analysis profile detects repeated delivery, review, capacity and operations friction, then writes attributed proposals into Dossiers with visible per-operator updates.

openDecisions.question: Where does periodic analysis live?
openDecisions.recommendation: A named improvement-scout profile inside the Watcher, with its own periodic step receipt.

openDecisions.question: How are improvement Dossiers grouped and maintained?
openDecisions.recommendation: Four initial themes with stable keys; prefer an existing Dossier when it owns the fix, and append attributed revisions.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: One Dossier per finding or one ever-growing global Dossier.

openDecisions.question: What can the scout publish without approval?
openDecisions.recommendation: Allowlisted, append-only findings and draft proposals in Dossiers; card promotion and rule changes require operator action.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Automatically change rules, running work or decided sections.

openDecisions.question: How is an update considered seen?
openDecisions.recommendation: Per-operator revision cursor advanced only by opening the revision summary or Dossier, with an explicit mark-seen action.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Clear all markers globally when one operator opens a list.

openDecisions.question: What cadence and budget should the scout use?
openDecisions.recommendation: One daily 14-day pass and one weekly 90-day pass per workspace, sharing Watcher contingent with a 10-call and 110,000-token weekly scout ceiling.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Analyze every five-minute Watcher sweep or share AGT-3019 capacity calls.

openDecisions.question: How should accepted card proposals promote?
openDecisions.recommendation: Use the existing promote-concept path and Task API, recording Dossier key, proposal id and scout run id.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Create loose cards directly from model output.

implementationTasks.title: Watcher scout receipt and one delivery-integrity finding
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read docs/orchestrator-improvement-scout/index.html, AGT-3018, AGT-3019, AGT-3015, and the Watcher domain. Add a named improvement-scout periodic profile inside Watcher scheduling, default off, with a daily due marker and one bounded 14-day aggregate for stale-run delivery versus card brief epoch. Reuse DecisionGroundsV1 and the AGT-3015 step record, including run content, source refs, model, tokens, cost or unknown price, failure and skip outcomes. Produce one shadow finding linked to the existing delivery-integrity Dossier; do not write a Dossier or card yet. Acceptance: the AGT-3010-style mismatch is found by the next due pass, duplicate scheduling creates one occurrence, no raw session enters the pack, and disabled or over-budget runs have explicit skip receipts.

implementationTasks.title: Dossier improvement kind and attributed append API
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and the Dossier/Task API contracts. Add an explicit improvement kind or origin to workbench.json schema and catalogue. Through an application-owned API, atomically append a dated scout revision with run id, stable finding/proposal ids, evidence refs, section-level change summary and digest to either a new keyed improvement Dossier or an existing keyed Dossier. Preserve decided content byte-for-byte and create a new open decision when challenging it. Make retries idempotent and reject stale revision bases, unknown keys and direct raw-stream refs. Acceptance: same run writes once, a stale write conflicts cleanly, existing decisions are unchanged, and catalogue filters can distinguish improvement Dossiers.

implementationTasks.title: Proposal deduplication, decisions and promotion
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier, the Watcher proposal store and promote-concept path. Keep proposals as Dossier children with problem, bounded evidence links, effect estimate, confidence, home, action and lifecycle receipts. Deduplicate against open cards and earlier proposals by issue fingerprint plus target scope; suppress rejected proposals until a new material evidence digest appears. Add one-action accept, reject and defer. Accepted open-card proposals promote the corresponding bounded implementationTasks slice through the existing promote-concept and Task API path with Dossier key, proposal id and scout run provenance. Acceptance: two duplicate runs yield one proposal/card, rejection is respected, deferral preserves review date, and no model response directly changes a rule or running card.

implementationTasks.title: Per-operator update markers and scout digest
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and frontend/AGENTS.md. Add per-operator Dossier revision cursors and a section/decision-level change summary projection. Show improvement and updated badges in central and project Dossier lists, Nordstern entry, board-linked Dossier chips, and Dossier viewer; show a short digest and proposal history with actions. Opening the revision summary or Dossier advances only that operator's cursor after successful content load; provide explicit mark-seen and preserve unread on failed load. Use shared tokens/components and no left accent bars. Acceptance: two operators have independent unread state, summaries distinguish new finding/open decision/recommendation change, counts equal visible filtered children, and relevant Playwright light/dark captures are saved.

implementationTasks.title: Remaining aggregate signals and incident calibration
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and the AGT-3019 capacity output. Add bounded aggregate producers for review requirement-fit, human-review waits, integration queue/gate classes, abort/salvage, cost per delivered card, quota, idle-capacity-with-waiting-work, weak evidence, repeated interventions and effective credential-source mismatch. Reuse Watcher cases and capacity receipts; include freshness, coverage, denominators and missing-data reasons. Add replay fixtures for all five 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-06 calibration incidents and proposal routing to existing owning Dossiers where applicable. Acceptance: all five generate the stated finding by the documented window without treating missing telemetry as a clean result or duplicating capacity allocation decisions.

implementationTasks.title: Rollout economics and operator history
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read this Dossier and the Watcher contingent contract. Enable workspace-scoped daily and weekly due passes with model/thinking resolution through OrchestratorSettingsResolver and PipelineStepConfigResolver, a 10-call and 110,000-token weekly scout subceiling within the existing Watcher contingent, and explicit no-call receipts on exhaustion. Show run history with findings, Dossier writes, proposals, operator responses, measured tokens and priced/unknown cost. Compare a four-week shadow baseline for precision, duplicate rate, missed calibration incidents and operator attention; expose a kill switch and no automatic rule mutation. Acceptance: weekly counters reconcile to AGT-3015 receipts, restart does not double-run or exceed budget, and operator history links every Dossier change to its run.
